description: Enhanced narration batch entries with loop-ready lines for all scenes

narrator: The mist ahead curls like white smoke, hiding the twists of the corridor.
Far away, a warm light glows at the end of the passage.
sir_james: I can see the light, but not the floor. Should we run, or make a plan?
gramps: Every knight chooses how to face the fog, lad.

claude_idle_hint.text: (Sniffing slowly) Woof... I smell loose stones near the walls, and solid rock in the middle.

gramps_risk_reflection.text: Quick feet can be brave, but a quick map can be brave and wise. Want to mark safe spots with your finger first?

sparky_safety_reminder.text: Zooming is fun, but I keep bonking my nose in this fog! Maybe we draw a zig-zag path before we blast off?

narrator_parent_injection.template: A calm thought drifts through the mist, sounding just like your grown-up: "${parent_text}"

sir_james_planner_success.text: Our plan worked! I feel brave and ready, not rushed and wobbly.

sir_james_brave_learning.text: Whoa! That was faster than I expected. Next time, I want to draw the path first so everyone feels ready.

narrator: Two paths stretch before Sir James and Claude.
The Sunny Path is wide and bright, with wildflowers dancing in the breeze.
The Shadowy Shortcut is narrow and dark, disappearing into thick trees.
sir_james: Which way should we go, Claude? The sunny one looks nice, but the dark one might be faster!
gramps: A knight always looks before he leaps, James. What does your heart tell you?

claude_sniff_hint.text: (Sniffing the air) *Woof!* The sunny path smells like warm strawberries. The dark one smells like... cold wet moss.

gramps_shadow_reflection.text: The shortcut might be faster, but can you see where your feet will land? Sometimes the longer path is the safer adventure.

narrator_parent_injection.template: A gentle voice floats on the breeze, sounding just like your grown-up: "${parent_text}"

sir_james_safe_success.text: The sunny path it is! Adventure awaits where we can see our way!

sir_james_brave_success.text: Into the shadows! I'm brave enough to try the shortcut. Claude, stay close!

narrator: The trees around Sir James begin to whisper secrets.
Listen close... 'The... mossy... rock... is... safe...'
sir_james: Did you hear that, Claude? The trees are talking!

gramps_listening_hint.text: Did you hear that, James? Use your ears. Not the thorn... the rock.

sparky_error_correction.text: Zzzzt! Ouchy! That's a sharp thorn! The trees said 'Mossy Rock'!

claude_idle_hint.text: (Ears perked up) *Woof!* I hear it too! Mossy... rock... safe!

narrator_parent_injection.template: The wind carries a familiar voice: "${parent_text}"

sir_james_fast_success.text: Got it! To the rock! I listened carefully!

sir_james_persistence_success.text: I had to listen really hard, but I heard it. The rock is safe!

narrator: The cave door is locked with a crystal puzzle!
The crystals glow in a pattern: Red, Blue, Red, Blue, Red...
sir_james: It's a pattern! Red, Blue, Red, Blue... what comes next?

claude_pattern_hint.text: (Sniffing the crystals) *Woof!* Red... Blue... Red... Blue... Red... I smell a pattern!

sparky_error_correction.text: Zzzzt! Look again! Red, Blue, Red, Blue... it keeps switching! What's next after Red?

narrator_parent_injection.template: A whisper echoes in the cave: "${parent_text}"

sir_james_fast_success.text: Blue! The pattern is Red, Blue, Red, Blue! I cracked the code!

sir_james_persistence_success.text: I see it now! Blue comes after Red! Patterns are like puzzles!

narrator: The river splits in two directions.
Two signs point the way. One says 'UP'. One says 'DOWN'.
sir_james: I need to find the sign that says DOWN. Let me look carefully!

claude_direction_hint.text: (Sniffing) *Woof!* The water flows that way... down, down, down! D-D-Down!

sparky_phonics_correction.text: Oop! That one starts with U-U-Up! We need D-D-Down! Look for the letter D!

narrator_parent_injection.template: Even the wind whispers what your grown-up says: "${parent_text}"

sir_james_fast_success.text: I knew it! DOWN! D-O-W-N! Full speed ahead!

sir_james_persistence_success.text: Phew! We figured it out together, team. DOWN it is!

narrator: Each rock has a word. Some rhyme with CAT!
sir_james: CAT... BAT... HAT... they all end the same! I need to find the rhyming rocks!

claude_rhyme_hint.text: (Tilting head) *Woof!* Cat... bat... they sound the same at the end! -at, -at, -at!

sparky_family_correction.text: Zzzzt! That's the -OG family! DOG, LOG, FOG! We need the -AT family! CAT, BAT, HAT!

narrator_parent_injection.template: A helpful voice floats across the water: "${parent_text}"

sir_james_fast_success.text: CAT, BAT, HAT! They all rhyme! I'm a word wizard!

sir_james_persistence_success.text: I found them all! The -AT family sticks together!

narrator: Listen: 'CL-CL-CLAP!' The echo bounces off the rocks.
sir_james: CL-CL-CLAP! I need to find the word that starts with that sound!

claude_blend_hint.text: (Clapping paws together) *Woof!* CL-CL-CLAP! I can clap! Which word starts like that?

sparky_blend_correction.text: Zzzzt! That starts with a different sound! Listen: CL-CL-CLAP! Find the CL word!

narrator_parent_injection.template: The mountain echoes your grown-up's voice: "${parent_text}"

sir_james_fast_success.text: CLAP! CL-CL-CLAP! I found it! I can hear the blend!

sir_james_persistence_success.text: I heard the CL sound! CLAP! Blends are like two letters holding hands!

narrator: A magical window appears, showing glimpses of Book 4!
sir_james: I can see new adventures waiting! Which one calls to me?
gramps: Every ending is a new beginning, James. What does your heart want to explore next?

gramps_future_hint.text: Every choice leads to a new adventure, James. What calls to your heart?

claude_celebration.text: (Tail wagging wildly) *WOOF WOOF!* We did it! We finished the whole book! I'm so proud of us!

narrator_parent_injection.template: Your grown-up's voice fills the air with warmth: "${parent_text}"

sir_james_completion.text: I did it! I learned to read AND had the best adventure ever! See you in Book 4!
